beats.headline: Gold crowd control box
beats.text: The gold crowd control box holds a pair of kneepads, three Scrolls of Confusing Fog and five Iron Skin potions. By its description the scroll fills the room with a mist that only the mobs can see, and the potion doubles Carl's physical armour for five minutes. The real prize is the kneepads. They aren't pants, but at least he has something to put on his legs.

beats.headline: Fog in the gym
beats.text: The Juicer twists at the waist and throws a weight at Carl's head, and it bursts into flames as it flies. Carl reads a scroll as the others descend on him. A thick, wet fog fills the room, blinding him for a moment before it fades to half opacity for him; water beads over everything and the ground turns slick. The troglodytes can't see a thing and run into each other and the scattered equipment. When it clears he reads a second. That one too lasts barely fifteen or twenty seconds, and with his ankle caught in a machine's wire he reads his last.

beats.headline: Wasted on a low intelligence
beats.text: Mordecai goes over the gym fight. Carl wasted those Confusing Fog scrolls. Next time, the party member with the highest intelligence should read any scrolls: with an intelligence of three, Carl made the fog last fifteen seconds, and Princess Donut's intelligence would have made it last a hundred and twenty seconds per scroll. Damn, says Carl.

beats.headline: Fog in the hallway
beats.text: In a hallway, a monster is finishing forming, the last of a black and purple mist twirling round it, and Yolanda is standing over a fallen man. Fog, Carl yells. Donut has read his mind and activates her scroll of Confusing Fog at the same moment. The wall of fog billows into the hallway as the creature drops to all six legs. It spins toward them, impossibly fast, cleaving through the cloud like a boat cutting through waves.

beats.headline: Six lions and a shell
beats.text: All six Mold Lions pounce at once in a dark street. Carl slams down Protective Shell, and on his word Donut casts the last scroll of Confusing Fog. A goblin smoke bomb he threw earlier caught the wind and came to nothing; the fog has no such problem. The lions bounce off the shell like fireflies off a bug zapper and ricochet away howling into the spreading fog. The shell lasts twenty seconds. Thanks to Donut's high intelligence, the fog stays a good two and a half minutes.

beats.headline: Three more, at last
beats.text: Two silver quest boxes each hold a thousand gold coins and a set of scrolls. One contains three Confusing Fog scrolls, which Carl likes much better than smoke bombs: the scrolls have saved them multiple times, and he has been out of them for a while. The other holds three Heal scrolls, for healing others without pouring potions down their throats.
